metadata.description: Market TIN/TAE/LTV reference data for the dynamic bank-vs-broker comparison engine (FASE 5). Populated at the user's explicit direction on 2026-08-25 from sourced 2025 market data they supplied directly in chat (not extracted from /docs). Individual named quotes below are market-comparator listings (e.g. Rankia, December 2025), not an official Banco de España/INE aggregate — see per-field 'source' citations.
metadata.disclaimer: No official cross-tabulated benchmark (type x bonified/non-bonified x bank/broker) exists at Banco de España/INE level. bankBonified/bankNonBonified per mortgage type are computed as the average of the named market quotes below carrying that label; broker is the single lowest-TIN quote across all of them — see /engine/marketTinResolver.ts for the derivation logic and its documented assumptions.
metadata.variableRateQuotesNote: The 4 VARIABLE quotes below (Banc Sabadell, ING — bonified and non-bonified) were added on 2026-08-27 at the user's explicit direction, sourced from /docs/TREBALL DE RECERCA/TREBALL/PART TEÒRICA/ESTUDI MERCAT HIPOTEQUES/ESTUDI MERCAT HIPOTEQUES_.xlsx (sheets 'BANCS SB'/'BANCS B', citing bancsabadell.com and ing.es mortgage simulators). Each quote's tin is computed as euribor12MonthAverage2025 (2.222%, see officialAnchors above) plus that bank's disclosed post-first-year differential over Euribor — not the temporary first-year teaser rate — so it reflects the rate that applies for most of the loan's life. No differential was estimated or interpolated; both addends come directly from the cited sources. On 2026-08-28, `initialPeriodTin`/`initialPeriodMonths`/`postFixedDifferentialOverEuribor` were added to each of the 4 quotes from that same source sheet (the 'TIN 1er any' and 'TIN resta d'anys: Euríbor + X%' figures already present there) so the UI can show the initial teaser period and the post-initial formula explicitly, alongside the unchanged steady-state `tin` used for cost calculations.
